name: Wiggle (basic)
description: Standard wiggle on the current property.

name: Wiggle (seeded, stable)
description: Wiggle with a fixed seed so it stays deterministic across renders and layer duplicates.

name: Loop Out (cycle)
description: Cycle the last keyframes infinitely after the final keyframe.

name: Loop Out (pingpong)
description: Pingpong the last keyframes back and forth.

name: Inertial Bounce
description: Classic bounce after the last keyframe. Amplitude scales with incoming velocity.

name: Spring Overshoot
description: Spring overshoot after the last keyframe.

name: Linear Remap (time → value)
description: Linearly remap a time window to a value range.

name: Ease Remap (time → value)
description: Eased remap of a time window to a value range.

name: Posterize Time
description: Quantize the result to N frames per second. Place at the top of any expression to lock its update rate.

name: Clamp Value
description: Clamp the current property value between min and max.
